<a id="UltraLaunch"></a>

### Launch of the ultra chargers

`UltraLaunch` · `src/committee.ts:29`

During the launch, cancelling a reservation on an ultra charger is always free.

**Not yet in force**: from 1 November 2026, until 31 December 2026

| What changes | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `body` | original rule | redefined rule |

<details><summary>The amendment, in the code</summary>

```typescript
{
  body: (previous) => (deps) => {
    const before = previous(deps)
    return (r, leadTime) => (r.charger === ChargerType.ultra ? r.price : before(r, leadTime))
  },
}
```

</details>

- Decided by: lea
- Reason: launch promotion for the ultra chargers
- In force from: 1 November 2026
- Until: 31 December 2026
- Amends (not in force): [Refund on cancellation](cancellation.md#Refund)
